experiment_data.hypothesis: ACT-256 ablation: ACT consistency training with 256 samples (128 pairs, matching GRPO data quantity) and reduced-LoRA config (r=64, alpha=64, 4 modules qkvo, dropout=0) to eliminate data-size confound in ACT vs GRPO comparison. If ACT-256 still significantly outperforms GRPO, confirms supervision granularity (per-token vs per-completion) as the key differentiator.
